host.description: Alternate hostname for creation of pidfiles. Overrides default hostname detection.

agents.description: Comma-separated list of agents to start. Example: 'ssh,gpg'.

dir.description: Directory to use for keychain environment files instead of $HOME/.keychain.

attempts.description: Number of times to try adding keys before giving up.

timeout.description: Timeout in minutes for identities added to ssh-agent. 0 means no timeout.

lockwait.description: Seconds to wait for the lock to become available.

use_gpg2.description: Use gpg2 instead of gpg for gpg-agent support.

no_inherit.description: Don't inherit any agent processes from the environment.

no_lock.description: Don't attempt to use a lockfile while manipulating files.

quick.description: If an ssh-agent is running, use it. Don't verify keys. Avoids locking.

keys.description: List of private key filenames to load. Looked for in ~/.ssh or paths specified in ssh config if --confhost was implied (though not explicitly exposed here, standard behavior applies). Items are strings representing key names like 'id_rsa'. items schema: { type: string, description: 'Filename of the private key to load' }

keychain_keys_list.description: Space-separated string of keys for internal variable usage.
